plan.scope: Independent continuum validation of all first seven original horizontal ST-2 modes, in vacuum and still air, about the gravity-loaded base.
plan.reference_method: Analytical continuous-rod tangent; exact nonlinear quaternion shooting base; midpoint collocation on two uniform material intervals; no OpenSwing imports.
limitations: Reference is specific to the common elastic/tension/CG-axis modal files; it does not validate other attachments or original static models.
Original printed complex-component intervals remain unchanged.
